meta.name: browser-extension-builder
meta.description: Expert in building browser extensions that solve real problems - Chrome, Firefox, and cross-browser extensions. Covers extension architecture, manifest v3, content scripts, popup UIs, monetization strategies, and Chrome Web Store publishing. Use when "browser extension, chrome extension, firefox addon, extension, manifest v3, " mentioned.

howto.what: 安装后，当你想构建或修改浏览器扩展时，Claude会提供架构设计、代码示例、发布指导等专业帮助。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器扩展”、“Chrome扩展”、“Firefox插件”、“manifest v3”等关键词时，Claude会接管对话。

say.text: 帮我写一个Chrome扩展，能自动替换网页中的图片
我的扩展在Chrome商店审核被拒了，怎么办？
say.note: Claude会分析原因并给出修改建议

howto.what_en: After installation, when you need to build or modify a browser extension, Claude provides architecture design, code examples, and publishing guidance.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like 'browser extension', 'Chrome extension', 'Firefox addon', or 'manifest v3', Claude takes over.

say_en.text: Help me write a Chrome extension that auto-replaces images on pages.
say_en.note: Claude generates manifest and content script.

say_en.text: My extension was rejected by the Chrome Web Store, what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes reasons and suggests fixes.
